successors.name: Ethiopian Empire
successors.text: Kaffa with the annexed Gimira states of She, Benesho and Majango

ledger.x: c. 1390: Minjo founds the Kingdom of Kaffa at Bonga. "The Kingdom of Kaffa was founded c.1390 by Minjo, who according to oral tradition ousted the Mato dynasty of 32 kings."
Reign of Gali Ginocho, 1675-1710: Kaffa begins to expand.
18th century: Mecha Oromo invade and take the land north of the Gojeb.
Reign of Shagi Sherocho, 1775-1795: Kaffa reaches the Omo.
1897: the Kingdom of Kaffa ends; "Kaffa was then held as a fief by Wolde Giyogis until 1914."

wars.name: Menelik's conquest of Kaffa
wars.outcome: Kaffa overrun in 1897 and annexed; Gaki Sherocho captured on 11 September 1897 and sent to Ankober.

wars.name: Kaffa-Amhara wars (1890 and 1893)
wars.outcome: The last king "had defeated two Amhara invasions of his kingdom in 1890 and 1893".

wars.name: Mecha Oromo invasion of Kaffa
wars.outcome: Kaffa repelled the invasion but lost all territory north of the Gojeb River.

certainty.note: The Gojeb River (north) and the Omo (east) are the only boundaries named.
